name: Furnio
googleShortDescription: Stage, enhance and edit property photos with AI, wherever work takes you.
description:
Give your property photos a fresh perspective with Furnio.

Create and manage property projects, choose photos from your device, and use AI-powered tools built for real estate imagery.

EDIT FOR THE LISTING
• Virtual staging: furnish empty rooms with selectable room types and furniture styles.
• Matched multi-view staging: work with multiple views of a space.
• Item removal: paint the area you want removed, with pinch-to-zoom and a precision brush preview.
• Custom staging: mark areas and describe the changes you want.
• Twilight: choose from three twilight moods.
• Winter to summer: transform a winter exterior into a summer presentation.
• Exterior enhancement: select supported improvements for your property photo.
• Floor plans: create floor-plan outputs from supported inputs.
• Reference furniture: use reference images to guide furniture placement.

FROM PROJECT TO FINISHED PHOTO
Follow job status, compare available originals with results, and save or share finished images. Add an optional disclosure label to supported clean-image exports. Trial previews retain their permanent Furnio watermark.

ONE FURNIO ACCOUNT
Access your existing Furnio projects, images and shared credit balance. Service availability, trial eligibility and credit requirements are determined by your account. Purchase Apple credit packs or a monthly Furnio plan in the app; verified credits are available on both the app and website. Existing website billing remains managed separately.

AI-generated images may contain inaccuracies. Review every result before use and follow applicable listing and disclosure requirements. Only upload images you have the right to use.
releaseNotes: Initial release of Furnio for mobile.
reviewNotesDraft: Furnio is a customer app for an existing real estate photo-editing service. Customers sign in to their shared Furnio account. Build 5 offers four Apple consumable credit packs and two Apple monthly subscriptions; Studio1200 is intentionally not offered on iOS. Apple purchases are verified server-side before credits are granted, and verified credits are shared with the same Furnio account on the app and website. Existing website billing remains separate. Account-specific service and trial eligibility are enforced by the same backend used by the website. Supply a verified, appropriately funded review account through the store's private review-access fields; never commit its credentials. Reviewers must be able to access all submitted functionality without waiting for an SMS from the developer. Account deletion is inside the app at Account > Account privacy > Verify my identity > Before you go > Prepare final review > confirm deletion.
unresolvedBeforeSubmission: Satisfy the Google Play account's closed-testing requirement before applying for Android production access.
